name: Organization Members
description: The owner of the org-admin tool pack. It holds the tools of Organisation: list the members and the sign-in requests that wait, set the roles of a member, suspend or reactivate a member, and approve or deny a sign-in request. It also lists, makes, changes and deletes groups and their members, makes and deletes custom roles, reads and replaces the overrides of a member, reads what a removal would seal, and renames the organization. Each change shows one card first. Each tool calls the admin routes as the member, and the routes decide each right. The main assistant loads these tools in a turn about the members. This agent is not a second assistant, and a hand-off to it is refused.
author: Metorite
